newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London steady, eyes Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London steady, eyes Wall St.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were unchanged to firmer in thin trade on Monday as most investors remained on the sidelines following Friday's sharp fall in New York, dealers said.
"It's a wait and see situation here," said one dealer. "No one wants to get involved until we get a lead from Wall Street."

The Nikkei/ISE 50 index gained 0.69 points to finish at 1,665.81 after the Nikkei 225 fell 284.93 points to close at 19,041.10. Dealers said the fall in Tokyo had been triggered by the Dow's 247 point drop on Friday.

However, dealers said the market felt underpinned at around the 18,500 level in Tokyo, although it was unlikely to surge out of the recent trading range until more positive news on the Japanese economy emerged.
